name: Bakemonogatari -Kamen Incubus-
original_name: 化物騙-かめんインキュバス-
source:
Presenting an assault adventure parody of "Bakemonogatari", the popular title both in the novel and anime form!

An incubus was looking for competent women for the procreation.
Then he hears about the girls who were once haunted by spectres, and decides to set its sights to them.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE066329.html]DLsite English[/url]]
